summary: Firefox’s media playback and audio systems received reliability fixes for seeking, live-stream duration, Opus decoder settings, and audio/video synchronization. The changes also make audio-device and AudioContext operations resolve on the media graph thread, improve I420 and NV12 image conversion (formats used to store video pixels), and update internal naming to the web standard’s Permissions Policy. Additional telemetry records media and capture behavior without changing playback controls.
